Actuator.description: Servo of one control surface: a first-order lag and a rate limit (surface deflection, rad).

model.description: Servo make and model, when known
model.title: Model

Actuator.title: Actuator

AeroSettings.description: Hand values that shape the aero model where the analysis has no data (the stall).
AeroSettings.title: AeroSettings

built_against.description: <aircraft>@<version> that the asset was made from
built_against.title: Built Against

dataset.description: The metadata of a dataset asset

inline.description: The dataset of an inline asset
inline.title: Inline

name.description: File name (file) or dataset name (dataset). Unique in the register
name.title: Name

package_path.description: Path in the package of an embedded asset
package_path.title: Package Path

role.description: What the asset gives, for example 'CAD mesh of aileron_l'
role.title: Role

size.description: Bytes of the file, or of the canonical JSON of the dataset
size.title: Size

tool.description: The spoke that registered the asset
tool.title: Tool

Autopilot.description: The flight controller and its output map.
Autopilot.title: Autopilot

BatteryData.description: The battery of a propulsion system (contract B /battery). The file has no internal resistance.
BatteryData.title: BatteryData

BuildRecord.description: Who built the file, with which AeroPlan commit, and which spokes gave data.

spokes.description: Spoke name -> what it gave in this build
spokes.title: Spokes

BuildRecord.title: BuildRecord

side.description: Which half of the parent carries the surface. both: every half the parent has
side.title: Side

DatasetMeta.description: The metadata of one dataset (a JSON value: an ADH DAVEfunc, or tables).

form.description: daveml-adh: an ADH DAVEfunc. tables: {name: {columns, units}}. parameters: {name: number}
form.title: Form

model_description.description: ADH ModelDescription: generation_tool, version, generation_date_and_time, author, description
model_description.title: Model Description

mrp.description: Moment reference point of the moments, design frame

sigma.description: ADH Uncertainty form. None: no uncertainty estimate exists in the source
sigma.title: Sigma

units_system.description: as-source: a published reference model kept in its own units. Each variable names its units
units_system.title: Units System

DatasetMeta.title: DatasetMeta

DatasetRef.description: A pointer from an ADH item to a dataset: `asset:sha256:<hash>` plus an optional `#/<path>` in the dataset.
DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef

EscData.description: The ESC of a propulsion system (contract B /esc).
EscData.title: EscData

Fidelity.description: L0 handbook, L1 AeroSandbox, L2 flow5/VSPAERO, L3 CFD/stand/CAD, L4 flight, REF a published reference model.
Fidelity.title: Fidelity

FlightEvent.description: One flight: the configuration flown, the as-flown mass and CG, the firmware and parameters, the segments.

package_hash.description: The `.muas` package of the configuration flown
package_hash.title: Package Hash

FlightEvent.title: FlightEvent

unverified_products.description: Product terms (for example ixz) stored as written by the source, sign convention unverified
unverified_products.title: Unverified Products

rate_frame.description: Frame that the velocity and rotation rates are relative to

values.description: Named state values in SI. Angles in radians
values.title: Values

Location.description:
Where a linked asset can be fetched: a path in the AeroPlan repository, or a URL. `member` names the file
inside a ZIP archive at the URL: a path, where a part that ends in .zip is a ZIP inside the ZIP.

repo.description: Path relative to the AeroPlan repository root
repo.title: Repo

Location.title: Location

placeholder.description: True when the values are a stand-in, not data
placeholder.title: Placeholder

MotorData.description:
The motor of a propulsion system (contract B /motor). kappa, r_tot and q0 are the constants of the chain that
made the contract file: d*V_bus = omega/(kappa*Kv) + r_tot*I, I = i0 + (Q + q0)*Kv.

kappa.description: ESC voltage factor of the chain (nd)
kappa.title: Kappa

q0.description: Friction torque of the chain (only when the rpm was measured)

r_tot.description: Motor, ESC and lead resistance of the chain

MotorData.title: MotorData

Planform.description: The parametric shape of a lifting surface. The ADH `geometry.lifting_surface` holds the same shape as splines.

structural_mass.description: Mass of the surface structure, when the tool gives it

surface_name.description: Name of the surface in its tool, for example 'Main Wing'
surface_name.title: Surface Name

Planform.title: Planform

PlanformSection.description: One section of a lifting surface, in the flow5 convention (right half, root first).

dihedral_deg.description: Dihedral of the panel outboard of this section, deg
dihedral_deg.title: Dihedral Deg

foil.description: Name of the foil of this section (lifting_surface.airfoil_sections)
foil.title: Foil

twist_deg.description: Twist about the quarter chord, nose up positive, deg
twist_deg.title: Twist Deg

x_offset.description: Leading-edge offset from the root leading edge, m
x_offset.title: X Offset

y.description: Span station, m, from the root
y.title: Y

PlanformSection.title: PlanformSection

PointMass.description: A concentrated mass of the mass model (for example a battery or a motor).
PointMass.title: PointMass

PropellerInstallation.description: Mount of a propeller or rotor in the design frame (WBS 1.2.3.9).
PropellerInstallation.title: PropellerInstallation

PropulsionSystemData.description:
The propulsion system that flies, from a Propalyser contract B file. Its Ct/Cp table and throttle map are a
dataset (`PropulsionTables`, role propulsion) in `muas.datasets` of the same node.

ixx.description: Propeller moment of inertia about the shaft

p_max.description: Shaft power at full command, the scale of power_fraction

PropulsionSystemData.title: PropulsionSystemData

created.description: None when the source does not record a date
created.title: Created

SafetyFactor.description: [M&S 29] b: a margin or factor of safety, with what it covers.
SafetyFactor.title: SafetyFactor

Segment.description: A time slice of a flight for one purpose (for example a doublet for system identification).
Segment.title: Segment

ServoOutput.description:
One output channel of the flight controller.

`sign` relates the PWM to the surface: +1 means a PWM above the trim gives a positive deflection in the
JSBSim sign (aileron rolls right, elevator trailing edge down, rudder trailing edge left). A throttle has no sign.

reversed.description: SERVOn_REVERSED on the aircraft. None when not recorded
reversed.title: Reversed

targets.description: muas.instance of each surface or propeller on this output
targets.title: Targets

ServoOutput.title: ServoOutput

Skin.description:
The outer skin of a part from CAD (for example a Creo shrinkwrap). It is a reference shape for the datum checks
and the tool views, not the geometry of the part. The file stays on the user's machine.

format.description: step_faceted: a STEP file of flat faces, with its own length unit. stl: an STL file in `units`
format.title: Format

units.description: Units of an STL file. A STEP file gives its own unit
units.title: Units

Skin.title: Skin

SoftwareRelease.description: A firmware release that flies on the air vehicle.
SoftwareRelease.title: SoftwareRelease

SourceRef.description: A pointer to a raw file that a spoke read: an asset of the register (1.10.2). The file stays linked.

role.description: What the file gave, for example 'T7 stability point'
role.title: Role

tool.description: The spoke that read the file, for example flow5
tool.title: Tool

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

Transform.description: Puts a CAD part into the design frame: each design axis is a signed CAD axis, then a shift in metres.
Transform.title: Transform

Tube.description:
A round tube between two items (for example the tail boom). The ADH `geometry.body` of the same item holds the
shape. This record gives the inputs of that shape, its source and its placeholder flag.

from_instance.description: The tube starts at the aft end of the body of this item
from_instance.title: From Instance

to_instance.description: The tube ends at the root quarter chord of the planform of this item
to_instance.title: To Instance

Tube.title: Tube

covariance_ref.description: File that holds a sysID covariance matrix
covariance_ref.title: Covariance Ref

per_point_column.description: Column in the points file that holds sigma
per_point_column.title: Per Point Column

sigma.description: Dataset-level value, in the units of the quantity
sigma.title: Sigma

VisualPart.description: The 3D shape of a part for a simulator view. The mesh is a raw file. The `.muas` holds its pointer and pose.

generator.description: How a tool makes the mesh when no CAD mesh exists
generator.title: Generator

hinge.description: Two points of the hinge axis, design frame, m
hinge.title: Hinge

mesh.description: The CAD mesh, when the part comes from CAD

tube.description: For generator tube: radius_m and to_instance (the item whose root quarter chord ends it)
tube.title: Tube

VisualPart.title: VisualPart

datasets.description: The datasets of this item (aero model, propulsion tables): pointers into the asset register
datasets.title: Datasets

geometry_tool.description: The spoke that wrote the geometry of this item last (flow5, OpenVSP). The changed tool file wins
geometry_tool.title: Geometry Tool

tube.description: The inputs, source and placeholder flag of a tube body (geometry.body of the same item)
